item.title: BlackGateWatch: A DNS Tunnel Hiding in Plain Sight
item.description: Three thousand frames of ordinary corporate DNS, and one workstation quietly hex-encoding data into subdomains of its own domain. No TXT records, no long labels, no obvious tell.

item.title: The Last Day: HR Said It Was Routine. The Logs Disagreed.
item.description: An insider threat hidden inside hand-crafted Windows event logs, records Event Viewer physically cannot show. The after-hours logon, the staged files, the 7-Zip exfil, and the flag buried in HR's own paperwork.

item.title: Packet Whisperer: The One Where DNS Snitched on Itself
item.description: DNS exfiltration reversed from a PCAP, pure Python, zero Wireshark. A complete walkthrough of how attackers smuggle data out via DNS TXT queries and how to catch them.
